reviews.text_en: It may not always be beautiful (meaning it's a bit noisy nearby), but the coffee is good and the desserts are delicious. It's worth coming here. Enjoy.

reviews.text_en: One of the best cafes I've visited. I got a brownie, and they said it was halal. I also got a cappuccino. My bill was 178 baht. 👍

reviews.text: Watch out! Power went out, they didn't know what to do, no manager present. They have no leader say the employee and walk away angrily! Never again
Don't go there, they treat you badly.

Super super slechte service gaan met je om alsof je niks bent ze hebben genoeg klanten dus zo gedragen ze zich ook, ze hebben geen leidinggevende die aanwezig is. De medewerkers doen wat ze willen en hoe ze willen. Ze communiceren niet goed samen dit krijg je zonder leidinggevende. Oude vrouw achter de koffie apparaat wilt niet communiceren ze maakt koffie als het je niet bevalt dan heb je pech gehad en vooraf betalen ook!!
reviews.text_en: Terrible, terrible service; they treat you like you're nothing. They have enough customers, so they act accordingly. There is no manager present. The employees do whatever they want, however they want. They don't communicate well with each other; this is what you get without a manager. The old woman behind the coffee machine doesn't want to communicate; she just makes coffee, and if you don't like it, you're out of luck. And paying in advance is bad too!!

reviews.text: A great place to grab a coffee! The AC is a total lifesaver and makes it a perfect spot to cool down. I highly recommend the Freddo Cappuccino—it was excellent. The coffee quality in general is very good. Definitely worth a visit!
Pyszna kawka, polecam :)
Действительно самый лучший кофе на Пхукете. Недешево, 100 бат за напиток, но чувствуется насыщенный вкус и качество. Несколько дней берем кофе с собой, флэт уайт - прекрасен
reviews.text_en: Truly the best coffee in Phuket. It's not cheap, 100 baht per drink, but you can taste the rich flavor and quality. We've been taking coffee with us for a few days, and the flat white is excellent.

reviews.text: Great coffee and deserts. Visited multiple times during my stay at Kata. Would definitely suggest to try.
Good coffee here

Very disappointing... The coffee is tooo bitter, however we paid extra for the medium roast. The barista is neither friendly, nor professional. When we asked if it was possible to change the coffee for cocao, the barista declined. The interior is cool, though

Great coffee shop and great atmosphere. Staff are friendly and very informative of the products but also they have great coffee and baked goods.

Highly recommend and not just for the dispensary but for the atmosphere and great coffee. Thomas had great service and he knew about all products and he was a great Barista too!

5 stars for the coffee! We had the iced toffee coffee and it was delicious! Felt like great Aussie coffee! The shop was open before 8, the lady stated come back in 10. So we arrived back at 8:10 and she was no where to be seen. We waited probably about 10 more minutes to get service.

Nice sitting area out the front to people watch, understanding that you can smoke your joint here but I wasn’t about that, so the minute someone lit up, off we went.
